title: Superman
image_role: 原创概念参考图；非原片截图、演员肖像或已核实镜头
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one crisp 16:9 high-resolution film work-card and full-screen original concept image. Make an invented cinematic scene inspired by the official 2025 Superman film's broad theme of compassion and goodness: a wholly fictional benevolent superpowered adult in plain unbranded dark civilian clothes hovers just above a storm-flooded city street at sunrise, guiding a family and their dog toward a small rescue boat while ordinary first responders work nearby. Show hope through human action, clear faces, a modern American city, rich cloud and water texture, cinematic depth and legible card-size composition. Original interpretation only; no Superman costume, cape, chest emblem, Clark Kent, actor likeness, film set, publicity pose, title, readable text, logo, watermark, border, blur, or direct film-frame recreation.
source_note: 原创洪水救援概念图，借用官方关于同情心与善意的主题；人物、洪水救援和场景均为生成时的演绎，非电影剧照、宣传物或演员肖像。
